title: Herschel Evans and the Lester Young rivalry
summary: Humes calls Herschel Evans one of the great ones and agrees with Dance that the supposed rivalry with Lester Young was not real, and that Herschel was a sweet man.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
